ig_caption:
Tue, Nov 10: 2,035 deer reported statewide (1,618 antlered, 417 antlerless). Season total: 95,391.

Newaygo's 45 new reports on Tuesday were 93% antlered, the highest share of any county with 25 or more, against 80% statewide. Lapeer moved past Shiawassee into seventh in the season rankings.
